llms.heading: English
llms.intro: Infinity Books Press curates world classics and their translations. Each work can have several language editions, and ebooks are read in the browser on this site.

home.title: Classic works, brought closer through every language.
home.description: Infinity Books Press curates the world’s classic works, presents their translations, and lets you read right in your browser. Explore a work, choose a language, and find the edition that suits you.

platform.title: One work, many editions.
platform.copy: Each classic can have several language editions. Every edition has its own translation, price and reading access, so you only choose what you want to read.

explore.title: Explore a work
explore.copy: Browse classics by author or topic and see which language editions are available.

language.title: Choose a language
language.copy: Each edition names its language and price before you buy. Changing the site language never changes the edition you chose.

read.title: Read in your browser
read.copy: Open your library and read on any device. Your progress is saved separately for every edition.

home.footerTagline: World classics, one language at a time.
home.shelfDescription: A growing shelf of classic works. Each card names the language of the edition you will read.
